plainText:
Hitmonlee, Baby! (One More Time) (Japanese: VS サワムラー VS ) is the 59th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 19th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
 and fly to 's house and break in by having Ditty transform into a key. Green tries to tap into the Pokémon Storage System, whilst Bill is asleep and unaware of her. Bill wakes up and mistakes Green for a regular burglar, sending out to stop them. Green counters this with Blasty. Green ties up Bill and his Vulpix, telling him that she believes that he is the Elite Four's next target. She then explains that she was the one helping and Bill when Lorelei had them cornered. Green tells Bill she'll protect him when the Elite Four come, as long as he lets her see 's Pokémon data, figuring he'd want to replace Pika. Bill agrees, and they find out that Red had recently obtained Vee.

They are then attacked by Bruno's Hitmonlee. Hitmonlee tries to flee and Blasty uses to fly after it, with Green and Bill holding onto its shell. The story ends with Bill asking Green where Yellow is. Green checks a tracking device, showing that Yellow hasn't moved from Vermilion City.
